claim_ceiling: MEASURED-OPERATIONS ONLY. This ledger classifies dispatches of ONE core lane under ONE direction version inside ONE day from the public REST job envelope and the persisted team refs on origin. It is not a benchmark, it adjudicates no packet, it moves no frozen bar or threshold, it accepts no Frontier verdict, it does not change human_gate_ready, and it certifies nothing about jurist usefulness. Job logs are HTTP 403 unauthenticated and were never read, so every statement about WHY a producer step ended is an inference from the measured duration arithmetic plus the persisted tree, never a read log line.

column_limitations.persisted_delta_files_measure: files changed by the persisted team ref's HEAD COMMIT against its first parent. It is NOT the delta over the lane base the dispatch started from, and it must not be read as one.

rows_where_the_delta_column_is_uninforma.reason: head commit subject does not match the workflow template 'evaluation cycle 39123055362 repair N' (core-lane.yml:159); the agent authored its own subject, so producer_commit_present reads false even though the run delivered
rows_where_the_delta_column_is_uninforma.why_affects_h1_false: the flag is only consulted on the failed-step branch; this row's producer step concluded success, so its classification is PRODUCER_SUCCESS regardless

measurement_corrections.audit_ran_reads_conclusion_not_status: GitHub reports a SKIPPED job as status=completed, conclusion=skipped. The first execution used the status predicate and is WRONG on audit_ran for every run; see superseded_first_execution.
measurement_corrections.persisted_tree_read_from_git_not_rest: the unauthenticated public REST API allows 60 requests/hour and returned HTTP 403 (remaining=0) during the first execution; the same commit subject and file list are read from the origin git object instead.

success_rule: H1 is SUPPORTED iff at least one run classifies as POST_DELIVERY_QUANTUM_DEATH AND at least one classifies as ZERO_DELTA_QUANTUM_DEATH AND every quantum_death run has audit_ran == false.

superseded_first_execution.why_superseded: the audit_ran column was computed from job STATUS, so all 14 runs reported audit_ran=true including the 4 quantum deaths whose audit job was SKIPPED; and the persisted-tree column depended on the rate-limited REST commit endpoint, which left 2 of 14 runs NOT_CLASSIFIED. Both columns are re-measured here. The four classification labels that were correct then  (39104154685 POST_DELIVERY, 39106938175 ZERO_DELTA) are unchanged.
